subtitles.en: Here we are in a trading range on the 10 year and at the low end we've been down into the high threes at the high end we're 475 and at 475 that's pretty much the high end of our range.

subtitles.zh: 如果10年期美债收益率达到5%，我认为那反而是配置机会。市场，尤其是权益市场，可能难以承受更高的利率。
subtitles.en: If we see 5% on treasuries on the 10 year I would tell you that is a buying opportunity I think the markets aren't able particularly the equity markets aren't really able to function as well.

subtitles.zh: 超过5%会收紧金融条件。而30年期美债历史上更多受通胀预期影响。
subtitles.en: Beyond that and I do believe it tightens financial conditions the 30 year however historically has traded much more on inflation concerns.

subtitles.zh: 我不认为30年期会到6%，如果真的到了，我会反向操作，大量配置6%的30年期美债。
subtitles.en: I don't see us going to 6% on the 30 year and if it does I would take the opposite view and I'd back up the truck and I'd buy a lot of 6% to 30 year treasuries.

subtitles.zh: 我们还看到另一个因素：不仅是财政支出带来的国债发行，还有数据中心和AI热潮带来的大量债务发行。
subtitles.en: I think that at this point in time what we're also seeing I said stratification earlier we're seeing that also in the pull up another factor that's happening and that is the sheer amount of debt that's being issued not just at the treasury

subtitles.zh: 因此，市场对资本的需求巨大，发行方倾向于在长端发行，这推高了长端利率。
subtitles.en: And as a result we're seeing this very significant amount of need for capital and they want to issue in the long end which is pulling rates up.

subtitles.zh: 你会配置这种长久期、超大规模的数据中心债务吗？还是认为在经济下行时，它可能比美国国债风险更高？
subtitles.en: Do you want to invest in that debt long duration hyper scale or debt or do you see that as potentially more toxic than US government debt should things turn south?

subtitles.zh: 我认为基础设施领域还有其他更合理的部分，比如电力建设和其他长期实物资产配置。
